Image 1 (Subject image 1) is the main subject. Treat it as the exact source, not as inspiration. Use the real person or object from this photograph exactly as it appears. Create a fixed 1:1 square conceptual editorial photomontage using the attached subject image 1 (image 1), the attached subject image 2 (image 2), and the attached subject image 3 (image 3)...

The final result must read as a layered geometric collage...

ADDITIONAL ELEMENTS
Add the following to the composition. Keep the layout and hierarchy described above.
Apply an authentic overprint texture to the affected element. Preserve the original shape, details, colors and information while giving the element a physical layered-print appearance.

Add scattered line cuts throughout the composition. Place some lines in front of the main subject and others across the background image, creating varied depth and visual interruption. Randomize the position, direction, length and spacing of the lines on every generation while keeping the composition balanced.

- {"condition":"always","instruction":"Use the selected color for all line cuts."}
